out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Summary Suspension for Imminent Health Hazard, Denial of Access, Failure to Comply
violations.observation: The establishment has been closed and the permit to operate suspended due to the following imminent health hazard: the walk-in refrigerator is broken and rat droppings were found in food items in the dry stock area.
violations.corrective_action: The establishment shall remain closed until ALL violations relative to the imminent health hazard cited in the inspection report have been corrected. A follow-up inspection shall be conducted to ensure the imminent health hazard has been eliminated. Please notify me when the violations are corrected. You may not operate until the Health Department reinstates the permit to operate. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT FACILITY HAS BEEN CLOSED DUE TO BROKEN WALK-IN AND RAT DROPPINGS BEING FOUND IN FOOD IN DRY STOCK AREA. A TECHNICIAN MUST BE CALLED TO REPAIR WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR AND PEST CONTROL IS NEEDED BEFORE REOPENING.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: No CFM was present during the beginning of the inspection. EHS was able to still get CFM credentials.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. PLEASE MAKE SURE A CFM IS PRESENT AT ALL TIMES OF OPERATION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw ground beef and raw beef skewers were being stored above ready to eat cooked samosas and cooked spinach.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. DUE TO WALK-IN BEING BROKEN, PIC THREW AWAY RAW FOODS THAT WERE BEING STORED ABOVE RTE FOODS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: due to the walk-in cooler being broken almost all food being stored inside of it were not temping properly. Cooked chickpeas (53F), cooked chicken (55F), cooked beef chunks (55F), fully cooked samosa (50F), raw salmon (53F), raw chicken (50F), raw chicken skewers (51F), raw ground beef (53F), raw beef skewers (52F) were all temping incorrectly at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. DUE TO WALK-IN BEING BROKEN, ALL FOODS NOT TEMPING PROPERLY WERE THROWN AWAY.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: no items in the walk-in cooler had a date mark on them.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. MOVING FORWARD, PLEASE MAKE SURE ALL FOODS THAT ARE KEPT LONGER THAN 24 HOURS MUST HAVE A DATE MARK ON THEM. DUE TO WALK-IN BEING BROKEN, ALL ITEMS NOT DATE MARKED WERE THROWN AWAY.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. RAID was found in the dry stock area of the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO ONLY HAVE A CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR SPRAY CHEMICALS IN THE FACILITY THAT ARE SAFE FOR COMMERCIAL KITCHENS. PIC THREW AWAY RAID.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. Rat droppings were found in food in the dry stock area of the facility.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PEST CONTROL IS NEEDED BEFORE FACILITY CAN BE REOPENED. GRILL KABOB (Inspection Date: 06/12/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the walk-in refrigerator was temping at 55F at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. FACILITY IS CLOSED DUE TO BROKEN WALK-IN COOLER. EHS WILL CONDUCT A FOLLOW-UP INSPECTION TO MAKE SURE WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR IS WORKING BEFORE REOPENING.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Back of house in facility is in need of a deep cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PLEASE CREATE A CLEANING SCHEDULE WITH EMPLOYEES TO HELP WITH DIRT AND GRIME BUILD UP IN BOH. PLEASE MAKE SURE TO DEEP CLEAN BEFORE YOUR NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
